name: Theme Builder
description: Live theme editor for the Jellyfin web client: colours, cards, details pages, player, presets and more.
overview: Adds a Theme Editor to the user menu with a live preview. The theme applies to every web client and is copied into Custom CSS for TV apps.

versions.changelog: Works with File Transformation 3.x again: its registration failed early in startup, so the Theme Editor menu entry, transparent top bar, night mode and per-title accent didn't load. Theme Builder now retries until File Transformation is ready. Also includes the 1.2.10 fixes (TV focus colours, round detail buttons, smaller Edit Images, A-Z picker).
